column4: stable/answer values.yaml and templates wire postgresql unconditionally, but upstream Answer defaults to embedded sqlite so postgresql is for scale only (upstream not verified, so unresolved)
stable/discordgsm values.yaml defines a postgres database block and postgres_ssl_mode, and the chart offers no other engine
stable/sheetable templates set DB_DRIVER postgres with host and credentials unconditionally, no other engine wired (upstream engine support not verified)
stable/vikunja values.yaml enables postgresql and redis but templates set no DB or redis connection env, and Vikunja defaults to sqlite (upstream not verified)

stable/anonaddy values.yaml enables mariadb and redis with DB_HOST and REDIS_HOST set unconditionally, valkey treated as optional on the assumption it only backs queues (upstream engine list and redis role not verified)
stable/baserow templates set DATABASE_* and REDIS_* unconditionally and the chart offers no other engine (upstream engine support not verified)
stable/cannery templates build an Ecto DATABASE_URL from the postgres block unconditionally, and the Elixir app uses PostgreSQL only
stable/docuseal templates build DATABASE_URL from the postgres block, but DocuSeal upstream defaults to embedded sqlite (not verified, so unresolved)
stable/ferdi-server templates set DB_CONNECTION pg unconditionally with no other engine wired (upstream engine support not verified, so unresolved)
stable/fireflyiii templates set SESSION_DRIVER and CACHE_DRIVER to redis unconditionally, so valkey is required for sessions, while postgresql is hardcoded but Firefly III defaults to sqlite
stable/firezone templates set DATABASE_* unconditionally and Firezone is an Elixir app that runs only on PostgreSQL
stable/friendica templates set MYSQL_* unconditionally with mariadb enabled, Friendica supports only MySQL/MariaDB, and REDIS_* is set but cache use is optional
stable/ghostfolio templates set DATABASE_URL from the postgres block (Prisma), and REDIS_* is set but redis is treated as an optional cache (upstream not verified, so unresolved for valkey)
stable/lancache-monolithic templates render prefill as a separate prefillImage workload enabled by default, which only pre-fills the cache and is not needed for the main container to start
stable/misskey values.yaml enables postgres and redis and templates wire both unconditionally, and Misskey requires PostgreSQL and Redis
stable/mixpost templates set DB_* unconditionally with mariadb enabled, and REDIS_* is set but treated as optional for Laravel queues (upstream not verified, so unresolved for valkey)
stable/nginx-proxy-manager templates set DB_MYSQL_* env, but Nginx Proxy Manager upstream defaults to embedded sqlite when no MySQL host is set (not verified, so unresolved)
stable/nocodb sets NC_REDIS_URL as a cache option and enables postgres, but NocoDB upstream defaults to embedded sqlite (not verified, so unresolved)
stable/observium templates set OBSERVIUM_db_* unconditionally with mariadb enabled, and Observium requires MySQL/MariaDB

stable/onlyoffice-document-server templates set DB_TYPE postgres and DB_HOST unconditionally, the document server needs a database, and REDIS_SERVER_* is set but treated as optional cache (upstream multi-engine support from memory, not verified)
stable/outline templates set DATABASE_URL and REDIS_URL unconditionally, and Outline requires PostgreSQL and Redis
stable/papermerge templates set PAPERMERGE__DATABASE__URL and PAPERMERGE__REDIS__URL unconditionally, and the Celery broker needs redis (sqlite alternative not verified)
stable/photoview sets PHOTOVIEW_DATABASE_DRIVER postgres, but Photoview upstream defaults to embedded sqlite (not verified, so unresolved)
stable/plausible values.yaml enables both the postgres block and the clickhouse block unconditionally, and Plausible CE requires both

stable/seafile templates set SEAFILE_MYSQL_DB_* unconditionally with mariadb enabled, and CACHE_PROVIDER redis is set but cache is treated as optional (upstream not verified, so unresolved for valkey)
stable/spotweb templates set DB_ENGINE pdo_pgsql and DB_* unconditionally with no other engine wired (upstream engine support not verified, so unresolved)
stable/teslamate templates set DATABASE_* unconditionally and TeslaMate is an Elixir app that supports only PostgreSQL
